pre_condition: command is a non-None value that is either an AgentCommand instance or an iterable of strings.
post_condition: Returns the standard input text that should be fed to the command's subprocess, or None when no standard input is needed. When command is a plain argument list (not an AgentCommand), the return value is always None. When command is an AgentCommand, the return value equals its stdin attribute — a string if stdin was supplied, or None otherwise.
